svg.title: FuseScope Collector topology
svg.desc: Inside a Kubernetes cluster, application pods on each node send OTLP over TLS 1.3 with a token to the FuseScope agent on their node, through a node-local Service. The agents send to the gateway over OTLP/gRPC on port 4322 with mTLS and a token. The gateway writes to ClickHouse over the native protocol and receives log pipelines, span mapping and the ingest policy from the FuseScope backend over OpAMP. Browsers and mobile apps send RUM to /rum/v1/* through an ingress, which re-encrypts to the gateway on port 4319.
svg.text: How telemetry reaches ClickHouse, and what is public
RUM · /rum/v1/* only · the one public path
pods → the agent on their node
telemetry; TLS to ClickHouse is optional
